title: Post-merge reconciliation: landing is derived from the ledger, claims are corroborated, silence is named
objective: Stop main from carrying work-package records that are false about landing. The gate derives each self-WP's landing from git log --first-parent origin/main (commit bodies carrying the WP's Work-Package line); a record may claim landed_as/CLOSED only if the ledger corroborates it; a landed-but-silent record is reported as LANDED_UNRECONCILED; a branch that adds a new WP record while any self-WP is LANDED_UNRECONCILED is refused.
business_value: WP-2026-0018 landed as c510516 and its record on main says IN_PROGRESS. Without a rule, every WP lands that way and the ledger lies by construction. Deriving landing from git needs no network, no per-WP autonomous PR, and no change to traceability.
in_scope: reconcile <WP> subcommand (offline; refuses unless the ledger shows the landing)
first application: reconcile WP-2026-0018 to c510516
acceptance_criteria: record claiming landed_as not on first-parent origin/main is refused
record claiming landed_as whose commit body lacks its Work-Package line is refused
CLOSED without landed_as and without closed_without_landing is refused
landed but IN_PROGRESS is reported LANDED_UNRECONCILED and repo still passes
a new WP record while any LANDED_UNRECONCILED exists is refused
reconcile refuses a WP the ledger does not show as landed
WP-2026-0018 is CLOSED with landed_as c510516 on this branch
evidence: mutation on verify_work_ledger + reconcile, unique anchors

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: This record will itself land IN_PROGRESS -- by design. It becomes LANDED_UNRECONCILED on main, is reported by repo, and is reconciled by the first branch that opens the next WP. Silence is named, never hidden.
